# Candice TTS runtime pins (WS-19) — verified 2026-08-21.
# Same versions on macOS arm64 and Windows amd64 (cp312 wheels exist for all).
#
# Provenance (FIX-023): every entry below resolves to a published wheel on
# PyPI; the full transitive set is frozen with per-wheel sha256 hashes in
# requirements.lock (regenerated by `uv pip compile`). Runtime worker
# (runtime.py) states: Python 3.12, kokoro-onnx 0.6.1, onnxruntime 1.29.0.
#
# Reproducible install (Python 3.12, virtualenv, hash-verified, network only
# for wheel download):
#   python3.12 -m venv .venv
#   .venv/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock
# (Windows: `.venv\Scripts\pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock`)
#
# Regenerate requirements.lock from this file (uv >= 0.11, deterministic,
# targets the Python 3.12 wheel matrix for both platforms):
#   uv pip compile requirements.txt --universal --generate-hashes \
#       --python-version 3.12 -o requirements.lock
# The lockfile must be byte-identical on regeneration; any diff means a
# dependency moved and the pins below must be re-verified.
#
# License / redistribution rulings (see src-tauri/tts/NOTICE.md):
#   kokoro-onnx 0.6.1      MIT (LICENSE verified in wheel, thewh1teagle)
#   onnxruntime 1.29.0     MIT (Microsoft)
#   soundfile 0.13.1       BSD-3-Clause
#   phonemizer 3.4.0       GPL-3.0-or-later (transitive via kokoro-onnx;
#                          PyPI classifier "GPL v3 or later (GPLv3+)")
#   espeakng-loader 0.2.4  GPL-3.0+ per NOTICE.md (bundles libespeak-ng
#                          1.52.0 + espeak-ng-data; wheel ships no license
#                          metadata — GPL applies to the bundled espeak-ng
#                          artifacts, verify in WS-44 before distribution)
